full_text:
TENDER DOCUMENT
 Procurement of Industrial Safety Helmets
Tender Reference No.
ISH/PROC/2026/017
Issuing Organization
ABC Industrial Manufacturing Corporation Ltd.
Tender Type
Open Tender
Delivery Location
Hyderabad, Telangana
Quantity
500 Nos.
Delivery Period
45 Days from Purchase Order
Bid Validity
90 Days
1. Introduction
ABC Industrial Manufacturing Corporation Ltd. invites bids from eligible manufacturers, authorized distributors, and suppliers
for 500 industrial safety helmets for use in manufacturing plants, warehouses, construction areas, and maintenance zones.
2. Scope of Supply

500 industrial safety helmets

Adjustable internal suspension/harness system

Compatible adjustable chin strap

Technical datasheet, test/certification documents, and warranty information
3. Technical Specifications
 Parameter
Requirement
Product
Industrial Safety Helmet
Application
Industrial, manufacturing, construction and maintenance
Shell
High-impact thermoplastic such as HDPE/ABS or equivalent
Protection
Mechanical impact and falling objects
Suspension
Adjustable internal suspension system
Size
Adjustable for different head sizes
Chin Strap
Compatible and adjustable
Colour
Yellow or equivalent high-visibility colour
Condition
New and unused
4. Safety Requirements
The helmet shall provide impact and falling-object protection, adequate shock absorption, a secure adjustable suspension
system, and no sharp edges or projections. It shall comply with the applicable Indian Standard for industrial protective helmets.
5. Standards and Compliance
The bidder shall identify the applicable Indian Standard(s) and submit conformity/certification details, test reports where
applicable, manufacturer information, product model, technical datasheet, and any mandatory certification details.
6. Quality Requirements
Helmets shall be free from visible defects, properly packaged, and carry required manufacturer, model, batch, or other
identification markings. Products must be traceable to the manufacturer and model.
7. Documents Required
Manufacturer authorization where applicable, technical datasheet/catalogue, Indian Standard compliance declaration, test
certificates, manufacturer details, warranty details, and relevant supply experience.
8. Inspection and Acceptance
The purchaser may inspect the helmets before or after delivery. Acceptance will consider quantity, specifications, physical
condition, markings, documentation, and applicable standard compliance.

9. Warranty
Minimum 12-month warranty from delivery against manufacturing defects. Damage from improper use, unauthorized
modification, or misuse is excluded.
10. Delivery and Packaging
Deliver 500 helmets to the designated Hyderabad warehouse. Packaging shall protect products during transport and show
product, model, quantity, supplier/manufacturer, and batch information where applicable.
11. Evaluation Criteria
Technical evaluation will consider specification compliance, applicable Indian Standards, certification/test reports,
documentation, traceability, warranty, and relevant experience. Commercial evaluation will be conducted separately.
12. Bidder Compliance Statement

Chin strap compatibility

13. Prototype Testing Objective
This sample tender is intended to test an AI-based Indian Standards recommendation system. The system should extract the
product, quantity, intended use, technical and safety requirements, then recommend applicable Indian Standard(s) with an
explanation of the match.
